import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Sales by Product (top left)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 0].bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color='#8B4513', alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group (top right)
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = ['#D2691E', '#CD853F', '#DEB887', '#F4A460', '#FFDEAD']
axes[0, 1].pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
               startangle=90, colors=colors, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Sales by Payment Method and Takeaway Status (bottom left)
payment_takeaway = df.groupby(['payment_method', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack()
payment_takeaway.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
payment_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 0], color=['#6F4E37', '#C19A6B'], 
                       alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black', width=0.7)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sales by Payment Method and Service Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Service Type', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Average Order Value by Size (bottom right)
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_avg = df.groupby('size')['total'].mean().reindex(size_order)
bars = axes[1, 1].barh(size_avg.index, size_avg.values, color=['#A0522D', '#8B4513', '#654321'], 
                        alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Order Value by Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Average Order Value ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Size', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add value labels on bars
for i, (bar, value) in enumerate(zip(bars, size_avg.values)):
    axes[1, 1].text(value + 0.1, i, f'${value:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
